user_reported_bug: After the initial SAM3 test endpoint was built and the ROBOFLOW_API_KEY was added, the end-to-end call to POST /api/admin/test-scene-segmentation returned HTTP 200 but every kept object came back with label='?', bbox=None, polygon=[], and 'material_error: object has no bbox — skipped material pass'. The response transport worked (16 raw / 13 kept above 0.55 confidence) but the parser inside intelligence/scene_segmentation.py:_parse_prompt_results was misaligned with the actual Roboflow SAM3 response schema and dropped every label, bbox and polygon on the floor. Confirmed by dumping the raw Roboflow JSON — real schema is `{prompt_results: [{echo: {text: 'cabinet', ...}, predictions: [{masks: [[[x,y],[x,y],...]], confidence: 0.75}]}]}` and my parser was looking for `pr['prompt']`, `p['polygon']`, and `{x,y}` dict points.

rca_of_the_issue: The previous parser expected prompt/polygon/dict-point fields that did not match Roboflow SAM3's real prompt_results schema. The fixed parser reads pr.echo.text for labels and p.masks list-of-contours with [x,y] points, restoring object labels, bboxes, polygons, and downstream material crop passes.
